# Python Source Code Structural Analysis

Performs deterministic structural analysis of Python source files using the tree-sitter parser. Extracts facts such as observed code components, symbol definitions, dependencies, API endpoints, test cases, test targets, and state transitions for engineering knowledge compilation. This enables evidence-based reasoning about code structure and usage.
